decisions.reason: After two years without website visibility, this peripheral consumer product likely sits well below aspiration levels and management would reallocate its resources to the firm's stronger industrial technology portfolio.

Although close to the core engineering business, the prolonged lack of visible market presence suggests weak traction or absorption into broader offerings, so a boundedly rational management would likely discontinue it as a distinct product line.

Its flagship status and core fit would have bought time, but by 2022 two years of non-observation would signal results below rising aspirations in a growing industry and make redeployment of effort more likely than continued support.

Despite its strategic fit with the circular-fuel direction, the extended disappearance from the website points to unresolved commercial or technical shortfalls, so management would likely drop it and shift resources into newer development projects.
